verdicts.title: Additive Powers-of-Two Quantization: An Efficient Non-uniform Discretization for Neural Networks
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose Additive Powers-of-Two~(APoT) quantization, an efficient non-uniform quantization scheme for the bell-shaped and long-tailed distribution of weights and activations in neural networks. By constraining all quantization levels as the sum of Powers-of-Two terms, APoT quantization enjoys high computational efficiency and a good match with the distribution of weights.
